SELECT i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, 
       AVG(CAST(cs_quantity AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg1, 
       AVG(CAST(cs_list_price AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg2, 
       AVG(CAST(cs_coupon_amt AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg3, 
       AVG(CAST(cs_sales_price AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg4, 
       AVG(CAST(cs_net_profit AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg5, 
       AVG(CAST(c_birth_year AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg6, 
       AVG(CAST(cd1.cd_dep_count AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg7
FROM (
    SELECT cs_bill_customer_sk, cs_bill_cdemo_sk, cs_sold_date_sk, cs_item_sk, cs_quantity, cs_list_price, cs_coupon_amt, cs_sales_price, cs_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2001
) AS filtered_sales
JOIN customer ON filtered_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ON customer.c_current_addr_sk = customer_address.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics AS cd1 ON filtered_sales.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics AS cd2 ON customer.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
JOIN item ON filtered_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
WHERE cd1.cd_gender = 'F' 
  AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary' 
  AND customer.c_birth_month IN (1, 3, 7, 11, 10, 4) 
  AND customer_address.ca_state IN ('AL', 'MO', 'TN', 'GA', 'MT', 'IN', 'CA')
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county)
ORDER BY ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
